_readme: KYC System Configuration. Three modes: workflow, scan, both.

_mode_description.workflow: Video liveness check + random word. Operator reviews manually via support ticket.
_mode_description.scan: Automated document scan via Onfido / Jumio / Sumsub. Instant result.
_mode_description.both: Try scan provider first. If not configured, fallback to workflow.
_mode_description.manual: Classic document upload only. Operator reviews file.

_word_ttl: How long the liveness word is valid (minutes). New word generated after expiry.

card_verification._enabled_note: If true: require KYC verified before large deposits, or match card holder name to KYC name.
card_verification._min_deposit_note: Require KYC if single deposit exceeds this amount (in user currency).
card_verification._match_note: Check that card holder name matches KYC document name (requires scan provider).

onfido._workflow_note: Optional Onfido Studio workflow ID. Leave empty to use default.

sumsub._level_note: Verification level name configured in Sumsub dashboard.

_max_file_note: Max upload size for videos and documents (MB).
_notify_note: Operator email for KYC ticket notifications. Leave empty to disable.
_ticket_tag: Tag added to support ticket subject for operator to filter KYC tickets.
